scenarios.name: Open client registration page via Join Healing Sky.
scenarios.criteria: Clicking Join Healing Sky and selecting Join as a Client displays the client registration page.

scenarios.name: Populate client registration form except phone number field.
scenarios.criteria: The inputs for full name, email, address, referral code, and date of birth fields hold the expected values. The address shows resolved details including postcode, and the three dropdowns for Date of Birth display 'June', '4', '1999'.
scenarios.endState: Four text inputs and three dropdowns on the page are correctly populated except the phone number field.

scenarios.name: Complete and submit client registration form.
scenarios.criteria: Submission succeeds if registration completion message appears OR navigation to /client/login occurs.
preconditions: All registration form fields except phone number are populated as per the scenario CLIENT-REG-002.
scenarios.startState: Registration page form inputs are set except the phone number field, which is ready to accept input.
scenarios.endState: Either a 'Registration completed successfully' message is displayed, or the application navigates to the client login page (/client/login).

scenarios.name: Navigate to client sign-in and proceed to OTP verification screen.
scenarios.criteria: After entering the configured test email and selecting Email as the OTP delivery method, clicking Log in displays the OTP verification screen.

scenarios.name: Verify OTP and log into authenticated client dashboard.
scenarios.criteria: Successfully verifying the configured client OTP displaying an 'OTP verified successfully' message and navigating to the authenticated client dashboard (/client/dashboard).
preconditions: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.

scenarios.name: Log out from client dashboard and return to homepage.
scenarios.criteria: Clicking the log out control results in the display of the Healing Sky homepage with the Log in option visible again.
scenarios.endState: Client is signed out and returned to the Healing Sky homepage with the Log in option visible.
